<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da with intensities matching the binomial distribution expected for carbon (13C) in a molecule containing ~18‑19 carbons. No other element shows such a multi‑peak pattern; chlorine, bromine, sulfur, etc., would give different characteristic patterns. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
